At Striker Asphalt and Sealcoating, LLC, we understand that even small cracks in asphalt can lead to major problems if left untreated. That’s why we offer professional crack sealing services to stop damage before it spreads. Our team uses high-quality rubberized sealants that bond with the pavement and flex with temperature changes, keeping moisture and debris out.

Crack sealing is one of the most effective ways to protect your asphalt surface from water infiltration, freeze-thaw cycles, and structural failure. Whether you’re maintaining a residential driveway, commercial parking lot, or a public roadway, early intervention through crack sealing can significantly extend the life of your pavement.

We take care to clean and prep every crack before applying sealant, ensuring maximum adhesion and long-term durability. Let Striker help you preserve your pavement and prevent small issues from becoming costly repairs.

Crack sealing is a key part of preventative pavement maintenance. Here’s how it helps protect your investment:

1. Prevents Water Damage
Sealing cracks keeps water from seeping into the sub-base, which can cause erosion, soft spots, and pavement failure.

2. Stops Cracks from Spreading
Unsealed cracks grow over time due to traffic and weather. Sealing them early prevents larger, more expensive damage.

3. Reduces Freeze-Thaw Impact
In colder weather, water in cracks can freeze and expand, worsening the damage. Crack sealing blocks moisture and minimizes freeze-thaw stress.

4. Extends Pavement Life
Routine crack sealing adds years to the life of your asphalt by maintaining its structural integrity.
